verified_against: G-Labs Automation Webhook API guide (app v5.0.8+), sections 5.1-5.7 and 9, fetched 2026-10-04
disclaimer: Hand-maintained local list. G-Labs Studio has no documented model-list endpoint, so an entry here does not prove the model is available on your installation, license tier or logged-in accounts. Errors returned by G-Labs are shown as-is.

image_models.label: Nano Banana 2
image_models.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google (Flow) account in G-Labs Studio. 4K upscale needs an ULTRA account.
image_models.notes: Default image model of the webhook API.

image_models.label: Nano Banana Pro
image_models.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google (Flow) account in G-Labs Studio. 4K upscale needs an ULTRA account.

image_models.label: Nano Banana 2 Lite
image_models.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google (Flow) account in G-Labs Studio.

image_models.label: GPT Image 2 (OpenAI)
image_models.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled ChatGPT/OpenAI account in G-Labs Studio (GPT Image 2 > ChatGPT Account). Output is capped at ~1.57 MP; no upscale.
image_models.notes: No `model` field is sent: the endpoint has a single model. References are positional (no @tag).

image_models.label: Grok Image
image_models.requirements: Needs an active Super Grok connection in G-Labs Studio. Output is 1K.
image_models.notes: Mode t2i is used without references, i2i with references. These are modes of /api/grok/generate, not model IDs.

image_models.label: Meta AI Image
image_models.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Meta (vibes.ai) account with image generation enabled in G-Labs Studio.
image_models.notes: References are sent as named fields (character_image / scene_image / style_image), one per role.

video_options.label: Veo 3.1 Fast
video_options.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google (Flow/Veo) account. 4 s / 6 s clips and 4K output need ULTRA accounts.
video_options.notes: Default video model of the webhook API.

video_options.label: Veo 3.1 Lite
video_options.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google (Flow/Veo) account. 4 s / 6 s clips and 4K output need ULTRA accounts.

video_options.label: Veo 3.1 Quality
video_options.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google (Flow/Veo) account. 4 s / 6 s clips and 4K output need ULTRA accounts.

video_options.label: Veo 3.1 Lite Lower Priority (0 credit)
video_options.requirements: ULTRA accounts only. Lower priority queue, may be slow.

video_options.label: Omni Flash
video_options.end_frame_note: Omni Flash start+end needs the G-Labs server config's i2v_end mapping; without it G-Labs rejects the request with a reason.
video_options.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Google account. No ULTRA needed (4K output still needs ULTRA). 360p is server-config gated.

video_options.label: Omni Vids (undocumented)
video_options.requirements: Only for G-Labs versions that document `omni_vids`.
video_options.notes: NOT listed in the webhook guide fetched 2026-10-04. The documented server maps unknown model values to veo_31_fast silently, so this entry is disabled. Enable it ("enabled": true) only if your installed G-Labs version documents omni_vids, and update durations/resolutions from that documentation.

video_options.label: Grok Video
video_options.requirements: Needs an active Super Grok connection in G-Labs Studio. One clip per request.
video_options.notes: t2v (text to video) and i2v (image to video) are modes of the Grok endpoint, not model IDs.

video_options.label: Meta AI Video
video_options.requirements: Needs a logged-in, enabled Meta (vibes.ai) account with video enabled. The first eligible account is used (no rotation).
video_options.notes: Clip length is not configurable in the documented API; clips are trimmed (or the last frame is held) to fit each scene. Start/end frames are sent as start_image / end_image.
